title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer or their designee to submit to the Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) the project ranking framework…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0582, Program]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer or their designee to submit to the Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) the project ranking framework for Los Angeles County for the 2027 SCAG CMAQ/STBG Call for Projects (Attachment A).
summary: Metro would authorize its CEO to submit Los Angeles County's project ranking framework to SCAG for the 2027 CMAQ and STBG call for transportation projects.

details.action: submit project ranking framework to SCAG
